M-INSTALL-FS.NAME: Installer filesystem and backups
M-INSTALL-FS.purpose: Atomic config writes and never-overwritten timestamped backups used by the DSH installer.

fn-atomicWriteFile.PURPOSE: tmp+rename write preserving file mode, with a typed CONFIG_WRITE_FAILED error.

fn-createTimestampedBackup.PURPOSE: Never overwrite an existing backup; append a numeric suffix on collision.

fn-listBackupFiles.PURPOSE: Discover timestamped and legacy backup residue next to a file.

fn-cleanupBackups.PURPOSE: Best-effort removal of installer backup residue.

CrossLink.relation: extracted from the installer in v3.6.0; installer re-exports these functions

contract.purpose: Atomic config writes and never-overwritten timestamped backups used by the DSH installer.

param.name: path
param.description: Absolute file path to write or back up.

param.name: backup
param.description: Absolute backup path returned by createTimestampedBackup.

error.description: The previous file cannot be backed up before an edit.

notes.note-1: Backups are never overwritten: a timestamp collision appends -1, -2, ….
notes.note-2: Writes use a temporary file in the same directory so a crash cannot leave a half-written profile.
notes.note-3: The installer refuses to edit a user config without a successful backup.
